# altr_classifier (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving information about a data classifier, including ALTR-managed classifiers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) ALTR Solutions, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
data "altr_classifier" "example" {
  name = "ALTR Managed - Email Address"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the classifier.

### Read-Only

- `collection_count` (Number) Number of collections this classifier belongs to.
- `collection_names` (List of String) Names of the collections this classifier belongs to.
- `compound_ruleset` (String) JSON object describing the compound ruleset, if the classifier uses one.
- `description` (String) Human-readable explanation of what the classifier detects.
- `minimum_threshold` (Number) Percent (1-100) of sampled values that must match for a column to be considered a match.
- `pattern` (String) Regex pattern matched against sampled column values.
- `sample_size` (Number) Number of values sampled per column when evaluating the classifier.
- `sample_type` (String) How values are sampled (e.g. ROWS). Empty for compound ruleset classifiers.
